title: Lacked reliable transportation
description: CDC PLACES model estimate (2025 release): adults who lacked reliable transportation in the past year, by census tract (county when zoomed out). Not measured in every state (none for TX, FL, PA and 8 others).

name: health-housing-insecure
source: CDC PLACES (local estimates from BRFSS), tract and county
title: Housing insecurity
description: CDC PLACES model estimate (2025 release): adults who experienced housing insecurity in the past year, by census tract (county when zoomed out). Not measured in every state (none for TX, FL, PA and 8 others).

name: health-utility-shutoff
source: CDC PLACES (local estimates from BRFSS), tract and county
title: Utility shut-off threat
description: CDC PLACES model estimate (2025 release): adults threatened with a utility shut-off in the past year, by census tract (county when zoomed out). Not measured in every state (none for TX, FL, PA and 8 others).

name: health-isolation
source: CDC PLACES (local estimates from BRFSS), tract and county
title: Social isolation
description: CDC PLACES model estimate (2025 release): adults who feel socially isolated, by census tract (county when zoomed out). Not measured in every state (none for TX, FL, PA and 8 others).

name: health-snap
source: CDC PLACES (local estimates from BRFSS), tract and county
title: Received SNAP (food stamps)
description: CDC PLACES model estimate (2025 release): adults who received SNAP in the past year, by census tract (county when zoomed out). Not measured in every state (none for TX, FL, PA and 8 others).

name: broadband-unserved
source: FCC Broadband Data Collection (National Broadband Map), via Esri
title: No high-speed internet available
description: Share of homes and businesses where no provider offers 100/20 Mbps service (FCC 'unserved' plus 'underserved' locations), by block group (tract, county and state when zoomed out). Latest FCC Broadband Data Collection, via Esri.
title_es: Sin internet de alta velocidad disponible

name: food-deserts
source: USDA ERS Food Access Research Atlas (2025)
title: Food deserts (low income, low access)
description: Low-income census tracts where many residents live more than 1 mile (urban) or 10 miles (rural) by road from a SNAP-authorized grocery store. USDA ERS Food Access Research Atlas, 2025 edition.

name: nri-risk
source: FEMA National Risk Index
title: Natural hazard risk (FEMA)
description: FEMA National Risk Index composite risk score (national percentile, 0-100: expected losses from 18 hazards, social vulnerability and resilience), by census tract (county when zoomed out). Dec 2025 release.

name: hud-lihtc
source: HUD Low-Income Housing Tax Credit database
title: Tax-credit affordable housing (LIHTC)
description: Rental properties built or rehabilitated with Low-Income Housing Tax Credits (HUD LIHTC database, updated Dec 2024).

name: hud-public-housing
source: HUD public housing developments
title: Public housing developments
description: Public housing developments run by local housing authorities (HUD).

name: hud-vouchers
source: HUD Housing Choice Vouchers by tract
title: Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8)
description: Housing Choice Vouchers in use as a share of renter-occupied homes, by census tract (HUD). Tracts with too few vouchers to report are blank.

name: hud-fmr
source: HUD Fair Market Rents (latest published)
title: Fair Market Rent (2-bedroom)
description: HUD Fair Market Rent for a 2-bedroom home (rent plus basic utilities), by FMR area (metro area or county). Latest published year in HUD's service (its notes say FY2024 but it was updated Sept 2025).

name: opportunity-zones
source: HUD / U.S. Treasury Opportunity Zones
title: Opportunity Zones
description: Census tracts designated as Qualified Opportunity Zones in 2018 (2010 tracts; HUD / CDFI Fund).

name: opportunity-zones-2
source: HUD Opportunity Zones 2.0 eligible tracts
title: Opportunity Zones 2.0 (eligible)
description: Census tracts eligible to be nominated for the 2027-2036 Opportunity Zones under the 2025 law (HUD, April 2026). Eligible is not designated.

name: cejst-disadvantaged
source: CEQ Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool v1.0 (archived 2022)
title: Disadvantaged communities (CEJST, archived)
description: Census tracts the former Climate & Economic Justice Screening Tool identified as disadvantaged: archived 2022 v1.0 (2010 tracts), as re-hosted by Esri. The tool itself is no longer online.

name: new-homes-permits
source: U.S. Census Bureau Building Permits Survey via HUD (through 2022)
title: New homes permitted (2022)
description: Housing units authorized by building permits in 2022, by county (Census Building Permits Survey via HUD; this service runs through 2022).

name: wildfire-hazard-potential
source: USDA Forest Service, Wildfire Hazard Potential 2023 (RMRS Fire Modeling Institute)
title: Wildfire hazard potential
description: USDA Forest Service Wildfire Hazard Potential (2023): how hard a wildfire would be to contain, very low to very high, lower 48 states. A modeled index, not a legal zone.
title_es: Potencial de peligro de incendio forestal

name: landslide-susceptibility
source: USGS national landslide susceptibility (Mirus et al.)
title: Landslide susceptibility
description: USGS map of where slopes are prone to landslides, lower 48 states.

name: sea-level-rise
source: NOAA Office for Coastal Management, Sea Level Rise Viewer (3 ft scenario)
title: Sea-level rise: 3 ft
description: NOAA: coastal land that would be under water at high tide with 3 feet of sea-level rise (all US coasts).
title_es: Aumento del nivel del mar: 3 pies (0.9 m)

name: storm-surge
source: NOAA National Hurricane Center, storm surge risk maps (Category 3)
title: Storm surge risk: Category 3
description: NOAA National Hurricane Center: how deep storm-surge flooding could get in a Category 3 hurricane (Atlantic and Gulf coasts, Puerto Rico, Hawaii).

name: environmental-justice
source: CDC/ATSDR Environmental Justice Index 2024
title: Environmental justice index
description: CDC/ATSDR Environmental Justice Index 2024: combined environmental, social and health burden, as a national percentile by census tract (zoom in to see tracts).

name: extreme-heat-days
source: CDC/ATSDR Environmental Justice Index 2024 (extreme heat days)
title: Extreme heat days per year
description: Average days a year above the local 95th-percentile high temperature, by census tract (CDC/ATSDR Environmental Justice Index 2024).
title_es: Días de calor extremo al año

name: social-vulnerability
source: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022
title: Social vulnerability index
description: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022: how hard it may be for a community to prepare for and recover from a disaster, as a national percentile (tracts; counties when zoomed out).

name: radon
source: USGS / EPA Geologic Radon Potential of the United States (2025)
title: Radon potential (1 low - 3 high)
description: USGS/EPA geologic radon potential by geologic province: 3 = high (test your home), 2 = moderate, 1 = low. Any home can have high radon; only a test tells.

name: faults-usa
source: USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold Database
title: Earthquake faults (US)
description: USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold Database: faults active in the last 1.6 million years.

name: landslides
source: USGS U.S. Landslide Inventory
title: Mapped landslides
description: USGS U.S. Landslide Inventory: landslides mapped by federal and state surveys.

name: fire-hotspots-usa
source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS active fires, via Esri Living Atlas
title: Satellite fire detections, US (24h)
description: NASA VIIRS heat detections in the last 24 hours, nationwide. Refineries and flares can show up as steady hotspots.
title_es: Incendios detectados por satélite, EE. UU. (24 h)

name: hms-fires
source: NOAA NESDIS Hazard Mapping System (fire detections)
title: Fire detections (NOAA HMS, today)
description: Fires spotted today by NOAA analysts on GOES and polar-orbiting satellite images (Hazard Mapping System).

name: smoke-plumes
source: NOAA NESDIS Hazard Mapping System (smoke)
title: Smoke plumes (satellite, today)
description: Smoke drawn by NOAA analysts from satellite images today: light, medium or heavy. It's smoke anywhere in the air column, not necessarily at ground level.

name: hurricanes
source: NOAA National Hurricane Center, via Esri Living Atlas (Active Hurricanes)
title: Hurricane forecast cones
description: Where active tropical storms and hurricanes may track (NHC forecast cones).

name: disaster-declarations
source: FEMA disaster declarations (DECS), last 365 days
title: Disaster declarations (past year)
description: Counties in a federal major-disaster declaration posted in the last year (FEMA). Overlapping shading means more than one.

name: open-shelters
source: FEMA National Shelter System (open shelters)
title: Open emergency shelters
description: Emergency shelters open right now (FEMA / American Red Cross National Shelter System).

name: recovery-centers
source: FEMA Disaster Recovery Centers
title: Disaster recovery centers
description: FEMA Disaster Recovery Centers open now, where survivors can get help in person.

name: epa-violations
source: US EPA ECHO (Enforcement and Compliance History Online)
title: EPA-regulated sites in violation
description: Facilities EPA lists as currently in violation of air, water or waste permits (ECHO). Click for the EPA facility report.
title_es: Sitios regulados por la EPA con infracciones

name: toxic-releases
source: US EPA Toxics Release Inventory, via ECHO
title: Toxic release sites (TRI)
description: Facilities that report toxic chemical releases to EPA's Toxics Release Inventory, with pounds released on site.

name: chemical-plants
source: US EPA Risk Management Program facilities, via ECHO (location only)
title: Chemical risk plan facilities
description: Facilities that store enough hazardous chemicals to file an EPA Risk Management Plan (location only; the plans themselves are not public online).
title_es: Instalaciones con plan de riesgo químico

name: drinking-water-violations
source: US EPA Safe Drinking Water Information System, via ECHO
title: Drinking water violations
description: Public water systems EPA lists with a current Safe Drinking Water Act violation (dots mark the system's office, not its service area).

view.where: sdwis_flag = 'Y' AND sdwa_compliance_status IN ('Violation Identified','Enforcement Priority')

name: water-systems
source: US EPA Community Water System Service Area Boundaries
title: Water system service areas
description: Which community water system serves an area (EPA). Many boundaries are modeled estimates; the popup says which.
title_es: Áreas de servicio de agua potable

name: brownfields
source: US EPA Cleanups in My Community (Brownfields)
title: Brownfields
description: Brownfield properties (possibly contaminated land) in EPA's cleanup programs.

name: gas-pipelines
source: US EIA natural gas pipelines (HIFLD copy, Esri federal data)
title: Natural gas pipelines
description: Interstate and intrastate natural gas pipelines (US EIA, about 1:250,000 detail).

name: nuclear-plants
source: HIFLD / US EIA power plants (nuclear)
title: Nuclear power plants
description: Operating nuclear power plants (HIFLD / US EIA).

name: nuclear-plant-rings
source: HIFLD nuclear power plant distance rings
title: Nuclear plant 10 and 50 mile rings
description: Distance rings around nuclear plants. The 10-mile ring is the emergency planning zone for evacuation; the 50-mile ring is for food and water protection.
title_es: Anillos de 10 y 50 millas de centrales nucleares

name: levees
source: USACE National Levee Database
title: Levees
description: Levee systems from the USACE National Levee Database, with FEMA accreditation.

name: leveed-areas
source: USACE National Levee Database (leveed areas)
title: Areas behind levees
description: Land a levee system protects (USACE). Levees lower the risk of flooding; they don't remove it.

name: social-security-offices
source: SSA open data: field office and resident station files (ssa.gov/data, CC0; the Internet Archive's copy when ssa.gov refuses scripts), geocoded with the U.S. Census Geocoder
title: Social Security offices
description: Social Security field offices and resident stations, with weekday hours (SSA). Most services work online or at 1-800-772-1213; call ahead or make an appointment.

name: legal-aid-areas
source: Legal Services Corporation, Find Legal Aid service areas (lsc.gov, CC0)
title: Free civil legal aid (LSC) - who serves your area
description: The nonprofit legal aid program funded by the Legal Services Corporation for each area, with its intake line: free help with eviction, benefits, family and other civil cases for people with low incomes (LSC).
title_es: Ayuda legal civil gratuita (LSC): quién atiende su zona

name: post-offices
source: USGS National Structures Dataset, post offices (The National Map)
title: Post offices
description: U.S. post offices (USGS National Structures Dataset). Many also take passport applications by appointment.

name: groundwater-usa
source: U.S. Geological Survey, USGS Water Services (waterservices.usgs.gov): instantaneous depth to water (parameter 72019) and daily values; public domain
title: Groundwater levels (US wells)
description: Depth to water at about 1,800 wells the USGS measures continuously, nationwide: the latest reading (last 30 days) and, for about half, whether the water is deeper or shallower than a year ago. Provisional data. California's DWR layer has many more wells there.
title_es: Niveles de agua subterránea (pozos de EE. UU.)

name: power-outages-usa
source: Oak Ridge National Laboratory, U.S. Dept. of Energy: ODIN (Outage Data Initiative Nationwide) public county outage summary (odin.ornl.gov), courtesy of ORNL
title: Power outages by county (ODIN, multi-state)
description: Counties where utilities that share data with the Energy Department's ODIN program report customers without power now (about 150 utilities so far; many, including PG&E, aren't in it yet, so a blank county doesn't mean no outages). Counts are meters out.
title_es: Cortes de luz por condado (ODIN, varios estados)

name: state-senate
source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb (2026 state legislative districts)
title: State senate districts
description: State legislative districts, upper chamber (Census TIGERweb, 2026).

name: state-house
source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb (2026 state legislative districts)
title: State assembly / house districts
description: State legislative districts, lower chamber (Census TIGERweb, 2026).

name: counties
source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb
title: Counties
description: County boundaries (Census TIGERweb).

name: county-subdivisions
source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb
title: Towns & townships
description: County subdivisions: towns, townships and census county divisions (Census TIGERweb).

name: census-places
source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb (Census Designated Places)
title: Unincorporated communities
description: Census Designated Places: named unincorporated communities (Census TIGERweb).

name: tribal-lands
source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb (AIANNH areas)
title: Tribal lands
description: American Indian, Alaska Native and Native Hawaiian areas (Census TIGERweb).

name: voting-districts
source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb (2020 voting districts)
title: Voting districts (2020)
description: 2020 Census voting districts (precinct-like). California and a few other states did not take part, so there are none there.

name: public-lands
source: USGS Protected Areas Database of the United States (PAD-US)
title: Parks & public lands
description: Publicly accessible parks, forests, refuges and open space (USGS PAD-US).

name: rivers-usa
source: USGS National Atlas, via Esri Living Atlas
title: Major rivers
description: Major rivers and streams (USGS National Atlas, via Esri).

view.where: Name <> ' ' AND Name IS NOT NULL AND Feature <> 'Stream Intermittent'

name: streams
source: USGS National Hydrography Dataset, via Esri Living Atlas
title: Streams & canals
description: Named streams, rivers and canals (USGS NHD, via Esri).

name: water-bodies
source: USGS National Hydrography Dataset, via Esri Living Atlas
title: Lakes & reservoirs
description: Lakes, reservoirs and ponds (USGS NHD, via Esri).

name: trails
source: USGS National Digital Trails (The National Map)
title: Trails
description: Hiking, biking and multi-use trails (USGS National Digital Trails).

name: land-cover
source: USGS / MRLC National Land Cover Database 2021
title: Land cover
description: What covers the ground: cities, farms, forest, wetlands, water (USGS NLCD 2021, lower 48 states).

name: crops
source: USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer (USDA SCINet copy)
title: Crops
description: Which crop was grown in each field last season (USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer 2025).

name: mobile-home-parks-usa
source: ORNL / DHS HIFLD Mobile Home Parks, via FEMA RAPT
title: Mobile home parks (US)
description: Mobile home parks nationwide, with number of spaces (ORNL / DHS HIFLD, via FEMA).

name: building-permits
source: U.S. Census Bureau Building Permits Survey (annual, by place)
title: New homes permitted (by city)
description: New homes each city, town or county authorized last year, by building size (Census Building Permits Survey, annual).

name: transit-stops-usa
source: BTS National Transit Map (CC BY 3.0 US)
title: Transit stops (US)
description: Bus, rail and ferry stops from every agency's GTFS feed (BTS National Transit Map, CC BY 3.0 US).

name: transit-routes-usa
source: BTS National Transit Map (CC BY 3.0 US)
title: Transit routes (US)
description: Bus, rail and ferry routes from every agency's GTFS feed (BTS National Transit Map, CC BY 3.0 US).

name: rail-crossings
source: FRA Highway-Rail Crossing Inventory, via BTS NTAD
title: Railroad crossings
description: Public at-grade road-rail crossings, their warning devices and train traffic (FRA, via BTS NTAD).

name: traffic-counts
source: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System 2024, via BTS NTAD
title: Traffic (vehicles per day)
description: Annual average daily traffic on freeways and major roads (FHWA HPMS 2024).

name: pavement
source: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System 2024, via BTS NTAD
title: Pavement roughness
description: How rough major roads are (International Roughness Index, inches per mile; over 170 is poor). FHWA HPMS 2024.

name: alt-fuel
source: DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center, via BTS NTAD
title: Alternative fuel stations
description: Public EV chargers and CNG, propane, hydrogen and biofuel stations (DOE AFDC, via BTS NTAD; updated daily).

name: truck-parking
source: FHWA truck stop parking (2019), via BTS NTAD
title: Truck parking (2019)
description: Interstate rest areas with truck parking and their number of spaces (FHWA, 2019).

name: poor-bridges
source: FHWA National Bridge Inventory, via BTS NTAD
title: Bridges in poor condition
description: Bridges rated Poor in the National Bridge Inventory, with deck and structure ratings (0-9, 4 or less is poor) and daily traffic (FHWA, via BTS NTAD).

name: ports
source: USACE Principal Ports, via FEMA RAPT
title: Major ports
description: The 150 principal U.S. ports ranked by tonnage handled (USACE, via FEMA).

name: work-zones
source: USDOT Work Zone Data Exchange (WZDx) feed registry: every keyless state/city feed; ALGO Traffic (ALDOT); 511GA / Georgia DOT, 511 Wisconsin / WisDOT, NVRoads / Nevada DOT, DriveNC / NCDOT, UDOT Traffic / Utah DOT, 511 Alaska / Alaska DOT&PF, 511LA / Louisiana DOTD, 511 Idaho / Idaho Transportation Department, AZ511 / Arizona DOT; OHGO (Ohio DOT)
title: Work zones (US)
description: Highway work zones in effect now or starting within 24 hours, from every keyless state and city feed in the USDOT Work Zone Data Exchange registry plus state 511 systems (refreshed hourly). California: see Lane closures.

name: road-incidents
source: Maryland CHART (MDOT SHA); ALGO Traffic (ALDOT); 511GA / Georgia DOT, 511 Wisconsin / WisDOT, NVRoads / Nevada DOT, DriveNC / NCDOT, UDOT Traffic / Utah DOT, 511 Alaska / Alaska DOT&PF, 511LA / Louisiana DOTD, 511 Idaho / Idaho Transportation Department, AZ511 / Arizona DOT; OHGO (Ohio DOT)
title: Road incidents & closures (US)
description: Crashes, closures, special events and other incidents reported by state traffic centers (Maryland CHART, Alabama ALGO, Ohio OHGO, and 511 in GA, WI, NV, NC and AK, more as keys are approved). Refreshed hourly.

name: message-signs-usa
source: Maryland CHART (MDOT SHA); ALGO Traffic (ALDOT); 511GA / Georgia DOT, 511 Wisconsin / WisDOT, NVRoads / Nevada DOT, DriveNC / NCDOT, UDOT Traffic / Utah DOT, 511 Alaska / Alaska DOT&PF, 511LA / Louisiana DOTD, 511 Idaho / Idaho Transportation Department, AZ511 / Arizona DOT; OHGO (Ohio DOT)
title: Highway message signs (more states)
description: Electronic highway signs and their current text in Maryland, Alabama, Ohio, Georgia, Wisconsin, Nevada, North Carolina and Alaska, more as 511 keys are approved (refreshed hourly).

name: road-weather-usa
source: Maryland CHART (MDOT SHA) RWIS; OHGO (Ohio DOT) weather sensors
title: Road weather stations (more states)
description: Roadside weather stations: air and pavement temperature, wind and humidity, in Maryland (CHART) and Ohio (OHGO). Refreshed hourly.

name: immigration-legal-help
source: U.S. DOJ EOIR, Recognized Organizations roster by state and city (geocoded with the U.S. Census Geocoder)
title: Immigration legal help (DOJ-recognized)
description: Nonprofits the Justice Department recognizes to give free or low-cost immigration legal help. Beware of 'notarios' (DOJ EOIR roster).
title_es: Ayuda legal de inmigración (reconocida por el DOJ)

name: detention-centers
source: U.S. ICE detention statistics, facilities sheet (geocoded with the U.S. Census Geocoder; the rest from a hand-checked list sourced to HIFLD prison records)
title: ICE detention facilities
description: Facilities holding people in ICE custody this fiscal year, with average daily population (ICE detention statistics). Find a detained relative with ICE's online detainee locator.

name: immigration-offices
source: U.S. DOJ EOIR immigration court pages and ICE field-office list (hand-kept, one source per row; geocoded with the U.S. Census Geocoder)
title: Immigration courts & ICE offices
description: Immigration courts (DOJ EOIR) and ICE field offices, each from its official page. Check a court case at 1-800-898-7180.
title_es: Cortes de inmigración y oficinas de ICE

name: health-centers
source: HRSA health center service delivery sites (gisportal.hrsa.gov)
title: Community health centers (sliding fee)
description: HRSA-funded health centers: care regardless of ability to pay, with fees on a sliding scale by income (HRSA).
title_es: Centros de salud comunitarios (pago según ingresos)

name: head-start
source: Office of Head Start center locator (headstart.gov)
title: Head Start (free preschool, ages 3-5)
description: Free Head Start preschool centers for children 3 to 5 from families with low incomes, including migrant and seasonal programs (Office of Head Start).
title_es: Head Start (preescolar gratuito, de 3 a 5 años)

name: early-head-start
source: Office of Head Start center locator (headstart.gov)
title: Early Head Start (babies & toddlers)
description: Free Early Head Start programs for pregnant women, babies and toddlers up to age 3 from families with low incomes (Office of Head Start).
title_es: Early Head Start (bebés y niños pequeños)

name: job-centers
source: U.S. DOL CareerOneStop American Job Centers (geocoded with the U.S. Census Geocoder)
title: American Job Centers (free job help)
description: Free help finding work, training and benefits, funded by the U.S. Department of Labor (CareerOneStop).

name: mental-health
source: SAMHSA FindTreatment.gov
title: Mental health care
description: Mental health treatment facilities, with Spanish and sliding-fee flags (SAMHSA FindTreatment.gov). In a crisis, call or text 988.

name: addiction-treatment
source: SAMHSA FindTreatment.gov
title: Addiction treatment
description: Substance use treatment facilities, with Spanish and sliding-fee flags (SAMHSA FindTreatment.gov).

name: housing-counseling
source: HUD-approved housing counseling agencies (HUD)
title: HUD housing counselors (free)
description: HUD-approved housing counseling agencies: renting, buying, avoiding foreclosure and homelessness (HUD).

name: public-housing
source: HUD public housing authorities
title: Public housing authorities (where to apply)
description: Where to apply for public housing and Section 8 vouchers (HUD).

name: colleges
source: NCES EDGE postsecondary school locations (IPEDS)
title: Colleges & trade schools
description: Colleges, universities and trade schools, 2025-26 (NCES IPEDS).

name: va-facilities
source: Veterans Health Administration facilities (VA)
title: VA health care & Vet Centers
description: VA medical centers, clinics and Vet Centers for veterans (VHA).
title_es: Atención médica del VA y Vet Centers

name: border-ports
source: BTS / CBP border crossing entry data (NTAD)
title: Land border crossings
description: U.S. land ports of entry on the Mexico and Canada borders (BTS / CBP).

name: summer-meals
source: USDA FNS summer meal site finder
title: Free summer meals for kids
description: Free meals for anyone 18 and under at summer sites, no paperwork (USDA). Seasonal: only sites open today are shown, so the map is empty outside summer.

view.where: Site_Type='OPEN' AND Dropped='False' AND Expired='False' AND Start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND End_date >= CURRENT_DATE

title_es: Comidas gratis de verano para niños

name: tx-burn-bans
source: Texas A&M Forest Service, county burn bans (gis.tfs.tamu.edu, updated as counties report)
title: County burn bans (Texas)
description: Texas counties under a burn ban right now and since when, as reported to the Texas A&M Forest Service. County judges issue and lift bans; check the county for details.

name: ar-burn-bans
source: Arkansas Department of Agriculture, Forestry Division (burn bans and wildfire danger page); county shapes: U.S. Census TIGERweb
title: County burn bans (Arkansas)
description: Arkansas counties under a burn ban issued by the county judge, with the Forestry Division's wildfire danger level. Updated daily.

name: reservoirs-usa
source: USDA NRCS Air & Water Database (reservoir storage reported by Reclamation, USACE and local operators); Texas: Texas Water Development Board, Water Data for Texas
title: Reservoir levels (West & Texas)
description: How full ~400 reservoirs are today, as % of capacity: the 12 western states (USDA NRCS) and Texas (TWDB). Provisional daily data.
title_es: Niveles de los embalses (Oeste y Texas)

name: ny-child-care-centers
source: New York State OCFS, Child Care Regulated Programs (data.ny.gov); centers and school-age programs only
title: Licensed child care centers (New York)
description: OCFS-licensed day care centers, small day care centers and school-age programs across New York State. Family day care homes are not shown.

name: pa-child-care-centers
source: Pennsylvania DHS, Child Care Providers (data.pa.gov); centers only
title: Licensed child care centers (Pennsylvania)
description: DHS-certified child care centers across Pennsylvania, with Keystone STARS level. Family and group child care homes are not shown.

name: tx-child-care-centers
source: Texas HHSC Child Care Regulation, operations list (data.texas.gov); licensed centers only, geocoded with the U.S. Census Geocoder
title: Licensed child care centers (Texas)
description: HHSC-licensed child care centers operating in Texas. Licensed, registered and listed child-care homes are not shown.

name: ca-lacounty-parcels
source: Los Angeles County Assessor / Enterprise GIS (LA County Parcel Map Service)
title: Parcels (Los Angeles County)
description: Every property lot in Los Angeles County from the Assessor: the parcel number (AIN), what the land is used for, and the assessed land and building values on the latest tax roll. Condo buildings show as one lot (individual units are left out). Zoom in close to see lots.

name: ca-lacounty-zoning
source: Los Angeles County Department of Regional Planning (Open Data)
title: Zoning (unincorporated Los Angeles County)
description: Zoning for the parts of Los Angeles County outside any city (East LA, Altadena, Florence-Firestone, Antelope Valley and more): the zone code, what it means, and the community. Inside a city, check that city's zoning instead.
title_es: Zonificación (zonas no incorporadas del condado de Los Ángeles)

name: ca-lacounty-general-plan
source: Los Angeles County Department of Regional Planning (General Plan 2035)
title: General plan land use (unincorporated Los Angeles County)
description: What the County's General Plan 2035 says each area outside city limits should be used for in the future (homes at what density, commercial, industrial, open space).
title_es: Uso de suelo del plan general (zonas no incorporadas del condado de Los Ángeles)

name: ca-lacounty-vote-centers
source: Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk (Election Vote Centers - Current, public view)
title: Vote centers (Los Angeles County, current election)

source: RIGIS / RI Division of Statewide Planning (Statewide Zoning, 2026)
title: Zoning districts (Rhode Island)
description: Every city and town's zoning districts in one map, with the local zone code, what the zone allows (residential, commercial, open space...) and the minimum lot size where set. Check the town ordinance before building or buying.
title_es: Zonas de uso de suelo (Rhode Island)

name: ri-zoning-overlays
source: RIGIS / RI Division of Statewide Planning (Statewide Zoning, 2026)
title: Zoning overlay districts (Rhode Island)
description: Special zoning overlays layered on top of the base zoning (historic, village, redevelopment, aquifer and flood overlays and similar), by town, with a link to the ordinance.

name: ri-future-land-use
source: RIGIS / RI Division of Statewide Planning (Statewide Future Land Use, Oct 2025)
title: Future land use plans (Rhode Island)
description: What each town's comprehensive plan says land should become (residential, mixed use, industrial, conservation...), compiled statewide in 2025. Shows where growth or protection is planned.
title_es: Uso de suelo futuro planeado (Rhode Island)

name: ri-land-use-2025
source: RIGIS / RI Division of Statewide Planning (Land Use 2025)
title: Land use today (Rhode Island)
description: How land is actually used now, mapped from aerial imagery: housing by density, commercial, industrial, farms, forest, wetlands and conservation land, with acres.

name: ri-hurricane-evacuation-zones
source: RIGIS / RI Emergency Management Agency (Hurricane Evacuation Areas)
title: Hurricane evacuation zones (Rhode Island)
description: Coastal areas that may be told to evacuate in a hurricane. Zone A leaves first (any hurricane), then B, then C for the strongest storms. Know your zone before a storm.
title_es: Zonas de evacuación por huracán (Rhode Island)

name: ri-voting-precincts
source: RIGIS / RI Board of Elections (Voting Precincts 2022)
title: Voting precincts (Rhode Island)

source: City of Providence (List of Polling Places 2026)
title: Polling places, Providence (Rhode Island)
description: Where Providence voters cast ballots in 2026, by precinct, with the address and how many registered voters use each site.

name: ri-water-supply-districts
source: RIGIS / RI Water Resources Board (Water Supply Districts)
title: Public water suppliers (Rhode Island)
description: Which water utility serves each area, where its water comes from (reservoir or wells) and roughly how many people it serves. Homes outside these areas are usually on private wells.

name: ri-sewered-areas
source: RIGIS / RI Department of Environmental Management (Sewered Areas)
title: Sewer service areas (Rhode Island)
description: Areas connected to a public sewer system, by the treatment plant that serves them. Outside these areas homes use septic systems (cesspools must be replaced).

name: ri-historic-districts
source: RIGIS / RI Historical Preservation & Heritage Commission
title: Historic districts (Rhode Island)
description: National Register and local historic districts. Exterior changes to buildings inside local districts usually need a historic commission review.

name: ri-historic-cemeteries
source: RIGIS / RI Historical Cemetery Commission
title: Historical cemeteries (Rhode Island)
description: Rhode Island's recorded historical cemeteries, including small family burial grounds, with the state cemetery number and town. Many are protected by state law.

name: ri-shoreline-rights-of-way
source: RIGIS / RI Coastal Resources Management Council (Designated Rights of Way)
title: Public rights of way to the shore (Rhode Island)
description: Paths, streets and stairs the Coastal Resources Management Council has designated as legal public access to the shoreline, with how you get there and what is at the water (beach, rocks, marsh).
title_es: Accesos públicos a la costa (Rhode Island)

name: ri-shellfish-closures
source: RIGIS / RI Department of Environmental Management (Shellfish Growing Area Classifications 2024)
title: Shellfishing closures (Rhode Island)
description: Waters where digging clams, oysters or mussels is prohibited or closed seasonally or after rain because of pollution. Shellfish from these areas can make you sick.
title_es: Zonas cerradas a la pesca de mariscos (Rhode Island)

name: ri-dam-inundation
source: RI Department of Environmental Management, Dam Safety Program
title: Dam failure flood areas (Rhode Island)
description: Land that would flood if a high- or significant-hazard dam failed, with a link to the dam's inundation map. Useful when choosing where to live or planning evacuation.
title_es: Zonas inundables si falla una presa (Rhode Island)

name: ri-broadband-block-groups
source: RI Commerce, Broadband Office (Rhode Island Broadband Map)

description: Share of homes and businesses in each census block group that are unserved or underserved by high-speed internet, from the state broadband map used to award BEAD funding.
title_es: Falta de internet por vecindario (Rhode Island)

source: City of Providence Department of Public Works (Utility Projects)

title_es: Obras en calles: proyectos de servicios, Providence (Rhode Island)

name: nh-road-construction

source: NH Department of Transportation (Projects In Design)
title: Road projects being designed (New Hampshire)
description: NHDOT projects in design that will go to construction in the next few years, with route, description and estimated cost. Public hearings are held before they are built.

source: NH Department of Transportation (NHDOT Plow Levels)
title: Snow plow priority by road (New Hampshire)
description: NHDOT plow level for each road it maintains in winter (level 1 roads are cleared first and kept bare), plus who maintains the road in winter. Helps plan winter travel.
title_es: Prioridad de limpieza de nieve por camino (New Hampshire)

name: nh-rail-trails
source: NH Department of Transportation, Bureau of Rail & Transit (Rail Trails)
title: Rail trails (New Hampshire)
description: Former railroad corridors turned into trails, with surface, length, seasonal use (snowmobile, OHRV, walking) and who manages them.
title_es: Senderos sobre antiguas vías de tren (New Hampshire)

name: nh-wildlife-management-areas
source: NH Fish and Game Department (Wildlife Management Areas)
title: Wildlife management areas (New Hampshire)
description: NH Fish and Game lands open for hunting, fishing, wildlife watching and paddling, with acres, game species and access notes.
title_es: Áreas de manejo de vida silvestre (New Hampshire)

source: NH Fish and Game Department (Wildlife Management Units)
title: Hunting management units (New Hampshire)

title_es: Unidades de manejo de caza (New Hampshire)

source: NH Fish and Game Department (Rifles Prohibited for Deer Hunting)
title: Towns where rifles are banned for deer (New Hampshire)

title_es: Pueblos donde se prohíben rifles para cazar venado (New Hampshire)

title_es: Zonas cerradas a la caza de aves acuáticas (New Hampshire)

title: Trout-stocked rivers & streams (New Hampshire)

title_es: Ríos y arroyos con siembra de truchas (New Hampshire)

source: NH Fish and Game Department (Freshwater Fishing Guide)
title: Freshwater fishing guide (New Hampshire)
description: NH Fish and Game's lake-by-lake fishing guide: species present, average and maximum depth, public access and directions to the launch.
title_es: Guía de pesca de agua dulce (New Hampshire)

source: NH Department of Environmental Services (Healthy Swimming Mapper)

title_es: Calidad del agua en playas (New Hampshire)

title: Public water system service areas (New Hampshire)

title_es: Pozos de monitoreo del agua subterránea (New Hampshire)

name: nh-village-centers

name: me-road-projects

title_es: Cuarentena por el barrenador esmeralda del fresno (Maine)

source: Maine Forest Service / Maine Office of Tourism (Foliage Report)
title: Fall foliage report (Maine)
description: The state's weekly fall foliage report by zone: how close leaf color is to peak. Updated each week in season.
